cohort: The study included pregnant women undergoing lower-segment Cesarean sections (LSCS) under regional anaesthesia.
finding: Levobupivacaine offered a longer motor block duration and was associated with fewer cases of hypotension and bradycardia compared to Bupivacaine, although both were effective for spinal anaesthesia in LSCS.
mod_finding: This study compared the efficacy and safety of two anaesthetic agents for spinal anaesthesia during lower-segment Cesarean sections (LSCS).
